themes.description: Users repeatedly express dissatisfaction that the brokerage fee per trade is excessively high, causing them to feel overcharged and discouraging frequent trading.
themes.business_impact: High brokerage costs reduce user profitability, especially for small traders, leading to lower trade volume (estimated 5–10% drop in daily trades) and increased churn, directly impacting the platform’s commission revenue.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The current flat‑fee pricing model is not competitive with other brokers and lacks tiered discounts or volume‑based incentives, creating a perception of unfair cost.
themes.action_plan:
• Benchmark competitor fees
• Design a tiered brokerage pricing model based on account balance or trade volume
• Implement promotional discount tiers for frequent traders
• Update fee transparency in the order confirmation flow
• Negotiate lower base rates with custodians
• A/B test new pricing structures
• Roll out changes with clear communication and marketing
• Monitor trade volume, churn, and user sentiment post‑launch
